description:
Use this when you need sunrise and sunset for a date and place, or where the Vedic day begins.
Sunrise, sunset and the next sunrise for a local date and place: upper limb at the sea-level horizon with 36.6′ refraction. The Vedic day runs from sunrise to the next sunrise.
Cost: 0.1 credit per call, billed as 1 credit per started block of 10 Ephemeris calls (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"date":"2026-10-06","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209}

latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees, north positive.

timezone.description: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Defines the local day.

name: get_ephemeris_sunrise

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

note.description: Present when the Sun does not rise or set (polar day or night); those fields are null.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.

title: Sunrise and sunset
